recognize_zh: 上方細胞細胞質內一束交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），左下細胞呈雙葉「蝴蝶狀」核、細胞質充滿粗顆粒，這兩項是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的關鍵線索。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed (butterfly) or folded nuclei
Moderate N:C ratio with nuclear contours obscured by dense granulation
Cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules
Faggot cell (upper center) containing a bundle of crisscrossing Auer rods
Irregular cell borders with clear peripheral cytoplasm in some cells; background normocytic red cells
describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal promyelocytes among red cells. The cells have folded to bilobed (butterfly-like) nuclei and abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules; one cell contains a bundle of Auer rods (faggot cell). Mature neutrophils are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type; confirm PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR and assess for DIC.

ddx.vs: The microgranular variant shares bilobed nuclei but has sparse or dust-like granules and few Auer rods, whereas these cells are heavily granulated.
AML with maturation shows round-nucleated blasts with occasional single Auer rods plus maturing neutrophils, without hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes.
Promonocytes have folded nuclei but fine lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, and lack Auer rod bundles.
